copy..letter-container: ✦ A Letter From My Heart ✦ Hey Bangaram! ❤️🥹 First of all, Happiest Birthday, Raa! 🎂💞 May Allah bless you with endless happiness, good health, peace, and countless beautiful moments. May He protect you always, guide you towards everything good, and fill your life with His mercy and blessings. May Allah accept all your duas and make every beautiful dream of yours come true. Ameen. 🤲❤️ Bangaram, I don't know how perfectly I can express everything in my heart through these few words, but I genuinely want you to understand how much you mean to me. Just saying... you're becoming more and more beautiful, pretty, and amazing with every passing day. ❤️ Sometimes, when I think about you, I feel so lucky to have someone like you in my life. You are not just someone I love; you are the person with whom I dream of building my entire future. And look at this little tree, Bangaram... 🌳❤️ This tree is filled with my love for you. Every leaf represents a little piece of my affection, every branch carries my feelings, and every part of it reminds me of the love I have for you. You know, a tree doesn't grow beautifully in just one day. It needs time, patience, care, and strength to survive every season. Sometimes it faces strong winds, heavy rain, and difficult weather, but it keeps standing and growing. That's exactly how I imagine our love. Just like this tree, I want our love to keep growing with time. Even when life becomes difficult, even when we face problems, and even when things don't go according to our plans, I don't want our love to become less. I want us to stand strong, understand each other, and keep growing together. This tree may become bigger with every passing day, but I promise you one thing: my love and commitment towards you will never intentionally become less. ❤️🌳 And Bangaram, there is something very important I want to promise you. I will definitely marry you, Insha Allah. Whatever situations come into our lives, whatever difficulties we face, and whatever problems stand in front of us, I will do my best to overcome them and make our dream of being together a reality. I am giving you this promise from the bottom of my heart. I don't want you to think of my love as just beautiful words or temporary feelings. I want my actions, my efforts, my patience, and my commitment to prove how serious I am about our future. I am working hard for two people who mean everything to me in this world — you and my mom. ❤️ My biggest dream is to become settled, build a beautiful life, and give both of you the happiness and comfort you deserve. Every effort I make, every difficulty I try to overcome, and every step I take towards becoming successful has a reason behind it. That reason is our future. I know life is not always easy. There will be responsibilities, financial struggles, unexpected problems, and difficult situations. But I am ready to work hard, face those challenges, and keep moving forward for the beautiful life I dream of sharing with you and my mom. I don't want to simply dream about a happy future. I want to work for it, struggle for it, and make it happen, Insha Allah. And one thing I want you to know very clearly, Bangaram... In my life, there is no place for another girl except you. My heart has chosen you, and my intention is to build my future with you. I want my love, loyalty, and commitment to remain sincere. I don't want anyone else to take the place that belongs to you in my life. ❤️ There is another beautiful dream I carry in my heart about my future wife. I strongly believe that, Insha Allah, you and I can build the kind of Islamic family I have always dreamed of. I want our life to be guided by the teachings of Islam and the boundaries of Shariah. I want us to read the Holy Quran, understand its meaning, learn and perform our Namaz regularly, and encourage each other to become better Muslims. I don't expect either of us to become perfect overnight. We can learn, improve, correct our mistakes, and grow together with patience. I want us to remind each other about Allah, support each other in practising our Deen, and make our home a place where Islam is valued and practised with love. I don't just dream of having a beautiful house or a comfortable lifestyle. I dream of having a life filled with Halal rizq, Allah's blessings, Barkath, peace, and strong Imaan. I want whatever we earn to be Halal. I want whatever we build to have Barkath. I want our decisions to follow the right path. Most importantly, I want Allah to be at the centre of our lives. I believe we can work towards this beautiful dream together, Raa. You and I, supporting each other, learning together, correcting each other with love, and asking Allah to guide us throughout our journey. We will make this dream a reality, Insha Allah. 🤲❤️ Bangaram, I know I cannot predict everything that will happen in our future. But I can tell you what I genuinely want: I want to choose you, respect you, stand beside you, work hard for our future, and build a life with you based on love, loyalty, understanding, and Islam. Whenever I look at this little tree, I want you to remember these words. Its growth is my little symbol of the future I dream about with you. No matter how many seasons pass, I want it to keep growing, just as I want our love and commitment to keep growing. Once again, Happiest Birthday, my Bangaram! 🎂💗 May Allah bless you today, tomorrow, and throughout your life. May He keep you safe, bless your heart with happiness, and guide both of us towards the beautiful future we dream of. I am working for that future. I am praying for that future. And I sincerely hope that one day we will look back at all these dreams and smile because, by Allah's grace, we made them come true. You, me, our dreams, our Deen, and a life full of Halal and Barkath — that's the beautiful future I am working towards. Insha Allah, one day, all these dreams will become our reality. ❤️🌳🤲 With all my love, Your's Pyari Habibi...❤️ ✦
